# IMatch.FrameTime property

The game time the round's last frame took: how much [`RoundTime`](./RoundTime.md) grew at the last [`Updated`](./Updated.md). It is zero from GO until the round's first frame.

```csharp
public TimeSpan FrameTime { get; }
```

## Remarks

Game time follows the game's speed, so it slows down during the winner's slow motion, and it stops while the game is paused.
